name: wyss-apps
description: Wyss Apps for Claude: look up Wyss Institute projects, science, people, faculty performance, grants and the costing-change queue as yourself, through the Wyss Apps MCP server. Claude Code uses the http server with your token; Cowork and Claude Desktop use the local bridge, which reads your token from ~/.wyss-apps/token.

wyss_apps_token.description: Your personal Wyss Apps access token (create one at https://wigt.med.harvard.edu/tools/claude_access). Starts with wyss_.
wyss_apps_token.title: Wyss Apps access token

wyss_apps_url.description: The Wyss Apps MCP endpoint. Leave the default unless you are testing a dev server.
wyss_apps_url.title: Wyss Apps MCP URL
